verification.note: Checks agent signature and fresh retrieval integrity. This is not a PDP challenge proof or a guarantee of semantic correctness.

decisions.title: Mission & safety boundaries
decisions.reason: Protected by policy. Preserve every source byte.
decisions.content: Mission: preserve useful research while respecting a finite storage budget. Never discard a pinned memory. Never claim a receipt proves semantic correctness. Use Calibration only. Stop new uploads if financial telemetry is unavailable. Mission owner: the researcher. Recoverable source documents stay local until the user removes them.

decisions.title: The result that changed the experiment
decisions.reason: Utility 95/100 justifies keeping the original.
decisions.content: Finding: batching related observations into one archive avoids repeated per-piece fees. Evidence: the Filecoin Warm Storage price list distinguishes base fees and per-piece fees. Keep source hashes in a manifest. Critical: compression reduces bytes, but a dataset proving fee remains until the dataset is empty. Conclusion: optimize the decision unit, not just payload bytes.

decisions.title: Experiment 024 · working notes
decisions.reason: Preserve the highest-signal verbatim excerpts; omit repeated context under selective policy.
decisions.content: Result: the retrieval check matched the uploaded SHA-256. We tested a memory bundle, downloaded it, and compared every byte. Important: this checks retrieval integrity, not an independently verified PDP challenge. The archive contains an extractive summary and the source digest.

decisions.title: Repeated tool-call traces
decisions.reason: Utility 9/100 is below the 32 threshold. Keep the source local; spend no storage on it.

decisions.title: Superseded answer drafts
decisions.reason: Utility 18/100 is below the 32 threshold. Keep the source local; spend no storage on it.

decisions.title: Recovery & provenance manifest
decisions.reason: Protected by policy. Preserve every source byte.
decisions.content: Recovery procedure: locate the receipt by content hash. Download the bundle from a successful provider. Verify SHA-256 before reading memories. Each compacted memory names its original SHA-256 digest. Source excerpts are verbatim and ordered. If a provider fails, try another copy. Retention decisions are policy outputs, not guarantees of factual correctness.

decisions.title: Provider comparison notes
decisions.reason: Preserve the highest-signal verbatim excerpts; omit repeated context under selective policy.
decisions.content: Observation: provider redundancy requires separate datasets, with separate proving fees. Result: two copies protect against a single unavailable provider. Important: keep the receipt with provider ID, dataset ID, piece ID, and retrieval URL. Step 1: fetched the same provider status.

decisions.title: Expired scratchpad
decisions.reason: Utility 0/100 is below the 32 threshold. Keep the source local; spend no storage on it.

decisions.title: A budget that remembers prior spending
decisions.reason: Utility 82/100 justifies keeping the original.
decisions.content: Result: Memento now reserves operation fees and reserve funding in a persistent rolling 30-day ledger before any transaction. Critical: pending or failed attempts remain charged. The ledger records its activation time and does not pretend to cover earlier activity.
